messages:
Mia: Quick heads up — curiosity from the quant bench: q4b-int8-v2 (quant4b-v2) shows ~4% drop on our golden paraphrase recall compared to baseline. Noticing a lot of duplicate/near-duplicate anchors in the new sample set. Can we run an overlap/dedup sweep before we escalate to model folks?

Jordan: Yep saw the numbers. Do we have a reproducible sample list? I want to make sure label queue isn't overloaded with duplicates.

Mia: I exported the failing subset to S3: s3://redwood-ml/curation/q4b-v2/recall-fail-2026-03-21.csv — it's ~3.2k rows. Suspect ~20% are anchor interleaves and paraphrase repeats.

Sam: If you can drop the overlap file I can run the intersection sampler. Command I use: `python tools/overlap_sampler.py --input s3://.../recall-fail.csv --banks anchorbank,seedbank --threshold 0.85 --out overlap_candidates.csv`

Mia: Dropped it to the bucket (same path). Also posted the quick diff: `gs://redwood-temp/quant4b-v2-diff.txt` for context.

ingest-bot: (automated) sampler-job queued by Sam at 2026-03-21 15:06 UTC — job id job_7729

Jordan: For label ops: if overlap candidate set > 1k we should dedupe automatically and only send 1-per-cluster to the label queue. Olivia — can your rate-limiter handle a burst if we send 2k cleaned?

Olivia: Yes, but prefer batching into 200s so we can monitor rater fatigue. I'll set a temporary throttle: `LABEL_BATCH_SIZE=200` and `MAX_QPS=4`. Also will add a note in the task template: "possible duplicate cluster — please mark all obvious repeats" :memo:

Sam: overlap run finished — produced 1,142 candidate clusters, 3,120 input rows. Output summary:
```
clusters: 1142
inputs: 3120
singletons: 812
avg_cluster_size: 2.73
```
I pushed cluster ids to s3://redwood-ml/curation/q4b-v2/clusters-1749056789.csv

Mia: Nice. Proposed flow: auto-collapse clusters >1 to a single canonical sample for labeling; append a "cluster_membership" column so we can later re-expand for eval. This should cut labeling cost and remove duplicate signal during golden checks.

Jordan: Agree. Also add a small canary: 5% of collapsed clusters should still send a second member to label to measure intra-cluster variation. Helps catch near-duplicates that change model scoring.

Olivia: Will implement canary in the dispatcher. ETA ~30m. I'll tag tasks with `qc:cluster-canary` and set priority low.

Mia: Great. After labeling, we should re-run the golden recall check against q4b-int8-v2 and the baseline, and produce the small eval diff; if regression persists >3% we'll open a model bug and attach the cluster CSV and a 50-sample human audit.

Sam: I'll also run a tokenizer-hash check — sometimes quantized kernels shift tokenization edgecases and create apparent paraphrase mismatches. Command: `python tools/tokenhash_audit.py --file clusters-1749056789.csv`

ingest-bot: (automated) dispatcher started by Olivia at 2026-03-21 15:18 UTC — 1,142 clusters, 200-batch mode.

Jordan: Thanks all — I'll watch label queue and surface any noisy batches. Mia — want a short postmortem doc if this ends up being an onboarding regression (inc. steps we took)?

Mia: Yes — please create a 1-pager in the curation-runbook repo under `postmortems/quant-onboard-1749056789.md` if we end up filing. For now marking `action: dedupe+canary` and @olivia will post ETA when dispatcher is live. :white_check_mark:

Olivia: Dispatcher live. First two batches queued. Will ping here if we hit >10% label rejects or any unexpected pattern.

Sam: tokenhash audit complete, no major token shifts found (pass). Attaching `audit_summary.txt` to the S3 folder.

Mia: Thanks everyone — will re-run bench after labels land and post results. If recall still down we'll escalate to model infra and quant teams.

Jordan: closing loop — keeping this thread for the run. Ping me if anything spikes. :slightly_smiling_face:
